task: independent numerics for K at a finite transfer endpoint T: (a) arity-one defect along K_b, quadratic sector; (b) flow W(P(eps,T), I + S^(1)(K_b))^(1); (c) arity-two defect along (eta1, eta2) in Sigma* x Sigma*, Gamma(eta1,eta2)|_V != 0

engine.imports: engine_a/r2_core.py (Step-1 engine A: field layout, vertex Hessians of I, Pnum, Khat, SDIAG)
engine.partial_files_of_earlier_run: not used (their 0-dim D-class check had failed; their formula sign for the special edge was not adopted without the own 0-dim check)

conventions.K_b: v(y) = |y|^2 b - 2 (b.y) y, two-component v^m = x^2 b^m - 2 (b.x) x^m; plane waves S^(1)(e_m e^{iP.y}), y^a -> -i d/dP_a
conventions.K_b distribution: graph_K = -( X2_ac d_a d_c delta(Sigma) + X1_a d_a delta(Sigma) + X0 delta(Sigma) ), Sigma = total momentum, leg 1 momentum p1 fixed
conventions.eta: eta1 = e_0 + e_5, eta2 = e_0 - e_5 in the engine-A basis of Sigma^*; eta1 in the +1, eta2 in the -1 eigenspace of rho(e_0 e_1 e_2 e_3) on Sigma^* (two-component: an S^alpha_i-type and an Sbar^{alphadot i}-type special supercharge); Gamma(eta1,eta2)|_V = 2 e_1
conventions.eta distribution: Y0 = coefficient of delta(Sigma) of -sum_{m1,m2} d_{P1,m1} d_{P2,m2}[...] (overall sign dropped)
conventions.special edge: K_eps - K_0 = Khat (e^{-eps k^2} - 1): t_0 = eps minus t_0 = 0; special-edge cycle (1/2) sum_sigma str[K S H P S H ...] (0-dim check kn_0d_cycles.json)
conventions.propagator: P(eps,T)(k) = Pnum(k) (e^{-eps k^2} - e^{-T k^2})/k^2 (ch08 def:c8-PT, prop:c8-twocomp)
conventions.units: unit = hbar tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(16 pi^2 (X,Y)) = -2 x (hbar/(16 pi^2)) for su(2) in an orthonormal basis
conventions.logT coefficient: T d/dT of the graph at T_max (exact: each P line pinned at t = T), cross-checked by fits in log T
conventions.what is summed: 1PI one-loop graphs (cycles) with all orderings and line types; not included: one-particle-reducible graphs (S^(1) on an external leg of a two-point subgraph) and counterterm trees -Q I^CT(K_b), -{S^(1)(K_b), I^CT}_eps; these depend on T only through P(eps,T)(q) at a generic external q, i.e. through e^{-T q^2}

composite_line_zero_mode_kernel.note: g0 = <G>/Z_b in engine units (hbar/(16pi^2)); design: coefficient 3/(8 pi^2) = 6/(16 pi^2) times the cut tree

a_defect_arity_one_K.logT_per_composite_graph: T d/dT X0 -> c_g (exp(-eps|p1|^2) - 1), c_g = +-9i (A_W,A_W), +-147/2 i (A_V,A_V), +-3 (lambda,lambda), +-18 (c,A^*) [unit]; exact in eps
a_defect_arity_one_K.logT_total: 0 at every eps (the two orientations of the composite A|_V--c line cancel pairwise in all four quadratic sectors); residual T d/dT X0 = O(eps/T)
a_defect_arity_one_K.T_dependence: X0(eps,T) - X0(eps,1e6) = O(eps/T) graph by graph; same for X1; X2 = 0 (translation component vanishes)
a_defect_arity_one_K.locality: X0(2p1)/X0(p1) = 2.000000 (A_W,A_W), 1.000001 (c,A^*): homogeneous polynomial in p1, no log|p1|
a_defect_arity_one_K.singular_parts: X0: none; X1: eps^-1 (18,0,-18,36)i (A_W), (-108,0,108,-216)i (A_V), 0 (lambda, c); no log eps within fit precision; T-independent

b_flow_K.logT: T d/dT X0 -> c_f exp(-eps|p1|^2) exactly, c_f = 6i (A_W,A^*_W), -46i (A_V,A^*_V), -8i (lambda,lambda^*), -3i (c,c^*) [unit]; nonzero as eps -> 0
b_flow_K.zero_mode_kernel: <G>_{S^3} of the K_b-combination of the composite A|_V--c segment = -6.0000 (b (x) 1) in units hbar/(16 pi^2) with the sign convention graph_K = -X0 delta, i.e. +6 = 16 pi^2 x 3/(8 pi^2) (ch08 prop:c8-Tsafe / design thm:o-ir (ii) normalisation); vanishes off the zero-mode support
b_flow_K.eps_to_0_at_fixed_T: finite after the regular fit, grows as c_f log T (table in results.tex)

c_eta_eta_arity_two.logT: T d/dT Y0 at T = 1e4 = c_eta eps exp(-eps|p1|^2), c_eta = -48i (A_W,A^*_W), +288i (A_V,A^*_V), 0 (lambda,lambda^*: no eta-eta chain graph), +48i (c,c^*) [unit]; carried by the P-edge eta-eta chains (share 1.0000)
c_eta_eta_arity_two.T_dependence: max_T |T d/dT Y0|, |T d/dT Y1|, |T d/dT Y2| = O(eps) at every T in {1e2,1e3,1e4}
c_eta_eta_arity_two.limit: the eps -> 0 limit at fixed T is T-independent (T d/dT -> 0); the total log T coefficient does not vanish at finite eps

ch08_items: CH08: remark 'The existence along $K$' (after thm:c8-K, unlabelled): its first sentence covers arity one only; at arity two along (eta1,eta2) with Gamma(eta1,eta2)|_V != 0 the log T coefficient of the defect is the first moment of the cut tree and carries the gradient of the special-edge factor, not e^{-eps|p|^2}-1; evidence: results.json c_eta_eta: T dY0/dT at T=1e4 = c_eta eps e^{-eps|p1|^2}, c_eta = -48i, +288i, 0, +48i unit in (A_W,A^*_W), (A_V,A^*_V), (lambda,lambda^*), (c,c^*), at eps = 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1 to 3e-5 relative, whereas at arity one T dX0/dT = c_g (e^{-eps|p1|^2}-1) per composite graph and 0 in the sum; proposed fix: replace the first sentence by "In the graphs of the defect along $K_b$ the logarithm in $T$ multiplies a tree that contains the special edge $K_\varepsilon-K_0$ at a generic momentum $p$, and therefore carries the factor $e^{-\varepsilon|p|^2}-1$; along $(\eta_1,\eta_2)$ with $\Gamma(\eta_1,\eta_2)|_V\neq0$ it multiplies the first moment of such a tree, which carries the gradient $-2\varepsilon p\,e^{-\varepsilon|p|^2}$ of that factor; in both cases it vanishes as $\varepsilon\to0$ at fixed $T$."
